 KERMAN, Calif. (FOX26) — Kerman Mayor Maria Pacheco released a statement regarding allegations against her.
 Kerman Mayor Maria Pacheco has been facing allegations of stalking and false imprisonment after mistaking a Fresno hairstylist for an ICE agent.
 The hairstylist, Eric Bridges, spoke with FOX26 regarding the encounter. 
 Pacheco says that she will go to court if Bridges would like to go to court.
 However, until that time, Pacheco says that she is focused on prioritizing the safety of the Kerman community.
